steps.text: The fastest way to bring in a statement is to share it straight from your bank's app. Open your statements there and pick a month.
PocketBudJet opens and reads every line. In a few seconds the charges are listed for you to check. Uncheck any you don't want.
Then tap the import button at the bottom.
The summary shows what came in: your income, your expenses, and what's left. Picked the wrong file? Tap Undo this import.
Home now shows your own numbers.
